Play Moonlight Peaks now on Nintendo Switch 2 and Nintendo Switch: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/moonlight-peaks-nintendo-switch-2-edition-switch-2/?utm_source=SW&utm_medium=soytnoa&utm_campaign=P1021-01&utm_id=P1021-01 

Step out of your father's shadow and onto your cozy, gothic farm in Moonlight Peaks! Uncover a sweet-and-spooky journey in this heartwarming, supernatural life-sim. Raise mystical crops, learn spell-casting and potion-making, and befriend—or even romance—the locals. Show your skeptical father that a life of compassion is possible... even for the undead.

author: Nintendo of America
description:
The Tetris® 99 55th MAXIMUS CUP event runs from 12 a.m. PT on July 10 to 11:59 p.m. PT on July 13. To participate, you’ll need to be a Nintendo Switch Online member* and play the Tetris 99 online mode during the event period. You’ll earn event points based on your placement in each match. Once you’ve accumulated a total of 100 event points, a new theme will unlock, featuring art, music and Tetrimino designs inspired by the Star Fox game for the Nintendo Switch 2 system! 

*Nintendo Switch Online membership (sold separately) and Nintendo Account required for online features. Membership auto-renews after initial term at the then-current price unless canceled. Not available in all countries. Internet access required for online features. Terms apply. nintendo.com/purchase-terms/
